articles.summary: COBOL is still a high-value labor market: demand remains strong in banking, insurance, and government, while a shrinking, aging talent pool keeps salaries and especially contract rates elevated.
articles.title: COBOL Job Postings Over Time: Salary Trends and Which Industries Are Still Hiring

articles.summary: The average COBOL developer is 58 years old, with approximately 10% of the workforce retiring each year. That rate has only accelerated as the cohort ages and talent is vanishing.
articles.title: COBOL Developer Retirement Rate vs. Training Pipeline
